rule: (the project rule): a term enters on the tuning seasons; the held-out seasons are reported and only veto. Re-scoring takes each kept term out of the full model and measures both splits. Evidence is the Stouffer z of the tuning and held-out t (equal weight), and the Benjamini-Hochberg q runs over every term in the ledger at once (one family, all models), so a q of .10 means about one in ten terms at that level is noise.     keep   q <= .10     drop   q > .10 and the held-out loss without it is no worse (removing it costs nothing out of sample)     watch  q > .10 but held out is worse without it (not proven, not free to remove)
